subject: Keystone SIG: control worksheet + evidence intake funnel
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@keystone.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: sam.ortiz@keystone.com; procurement@keystone.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Keystone SIG worksheet + evidence intake

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the demo last week — Keystone is moving this through our vendor security review and we need a couple of things to progress to procurement: a completed SIG control worksheet (we attached the template) and a small set of evidence artifacts for the controls marked as "in scope".

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Provide a completed SIG worksheet mapping to Redwood controls (row-by-row)
- Deliver evidence for the following control families: Key Management, Logical Access, Change Control, and Logging
- Provide a contact for artifact delivery and a secure upload method (SFTP/secure Drive)

Target timeline on our end: receive worksheet + initial artifacts by EOD Wednesday (7/19). Our security team will do a light review and then request follow-ups if needed.

Attachments: Keystone_SIG_Template.xlsx (for your mapping)

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Senior Vendor Security Manager
Keystone Financial
From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@keystone.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Keystone SIG worksheet + evidence intake

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We're on it. Quick plan below and owners assigned: 

Plan & owners:
- SIG control mapping (worksheet): Sofia (owner) — we'll fill the template with control IDs and crosswalks to Redwood control docs.
- Key Management evidence: Mina (owner) — will provide KM policy excerpts, rotation schedule, and sample rotation logs.
- Logging / access artifacts: Karthik (owner) — will pull a redacted access log snapshot and the logging retention policy.
- Change control artifacts: Naomi (owner) — will include PR/approval workflow screenshots and a sample change ticket.

Delivery method: We can share a secure, read-only folder on our customer drive. If Keystone prefers SFTP, we can provision a temporary account and a hashed upload token — let us know.

Checklist we'll deliver by 2028-07-19 EOD:
1) Completed SIG worksheet (keystone template)
2) Mapping document: redwood_control-mapping-v1.md (explains evidence per control)
3) Selected artifacts (redacted where required): kms_key_rotation_logs_2028-06.csv, access_logs_sample_2028-06.tar.gz, change-ticket-screenshot.png

If you want a short handoff call early next week for context while you review, happy to schedule.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Assurance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@keystone.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@keystone.com>; procurement@keystone.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deliverable: SIG worksheet + initial evidence (Keystone)

Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarification items from our security reviewers: 
1) For Key Management: can you confirm where customer data keys are encrypted (KMS provider and region) and provide the key policy excerpt that shows separation of duties? The rotation log sample is helpful but reviewers want a short narrative and the policy snippet.
2) For Access logs: can you confirm whether logs include full request URIs or are scrubbed, and provide the retention configuration (how long logs are retained hot/cold)?
3) For Change control: need the ticket that shows an emergency rollback path and any post-change validation artifacts.

We can accept redacted excerpts. If it's easier, can you bundle these three follow-ups as a short addendum to the Drive folder? Ideally by EOD today (7/19) so procurement can continue.

Thanks,
Sam
From: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
To: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@keystone.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@keystone.com>
Cc: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deliverable: SIG worksheet + initial evidence (Keystone)

Sam / Alyssa — thanks for the pointers. We added an addendum to the Drive: "SIG_Addendum_Keystone_2028-07-19.md" that contains the requested snippets and narratives. Summary of what we placed in the folder:

- Key Management narrative: where customer-encryption-keys are wrapped (AWS KMS us-west-2) and a redacted key policy excerpt showing separation of duties between the service account and ops approvers. (file: kms_policy_excerpt_redacted.txt)
- Rotation logs: sample CSV with rotation timestamps and nonces (kms_key_rotation_logs_2028-06.csv).
- Logging retention: descriptive snippet and retention config (logging_retention_policy.md) — hot logs retained 30 days, archived 2 years.
- Access logs: we confirm URIs are partially scrubbed (query parameters removed). Sample archive uploaded (access_logs_sample_2028-06.tar.gz).
- Change control: emergency rollback screenshot + post-change validation checklist (change-ticket-screenshot.png, post-change-validation.pdf)

Link to updated folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Keystone/SIG-2028

If you want a 15-minute sync to walk the reviewers through the artifacts, reply with availability and we’ll set it up.

Best regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
